name: event-dialog-visual
description: Visual verification of the event dialog system: event categories (Unions, Politics, Weather, Mafia, Lawsuits), dialog with title/description/options, consequence display, and state updates after resolution. Every event raised by an explicit `event fire` is now answered and dismissed by clicking the dialog's own buttons (issue #479); `event fire` itself stays a command because it is a test hook with no player-facing equivalent.

steps.description: event fire union_coffee_uprising — test hook: `event fire` has no UI control and none is intended (a player cannot summon an event on demand). Left unmarked (legacy/unconstrained) rather than mislabelled.

expect.note: real click resolves union_coffee_uprising option 0 -- Lost $8000, wellBeing +12, matching the command-mode consequence text exactly

steps.description: Resolved through the event dialog's own buttons. Decides whether an event is pending from authoritative game state, not from whether the modal has rendered -- a DOM-only probe silently missed events on a no-GPU runner where a frame costs ~6s, leaving them pending so later ticks halted and the run diverged while still passing command mode.

event fire tutorial_synergy_consultant — test hook: `event fire` has no UI control and none is intended (a player cannot summon an event on demand). Left unmarked (legacy/unconstrained) rather than mislabelled.

expect.note: real click on the 2nd option (nth-child(2), index 1) resolves tutorial_synergy_consultant's 'Get off my site' -- no cash cost, wellBeing -10/safety -5, confirming the dialog's 2nd-choice selector reaches the same option `event choose 1` names
